title: Annex A.4 - Resources for AI systems
description: Working paper for Annex A.4: data, tooling, system and computing resources, human resources for AI systems.

sections.title: Data resources (A.4.3)
prompts: Verify data inventories exist with provenance, licensing, sensitivity.
Confirm data quality controls per stage (collection, labeling, validation).

sections.title: Tooling and system resources (A.4.4 / A.4.5)
prompts: Confirm tool register including approved development frameworks.
Verify infrastructure capacity planning for training and inference.

sections.title: Human resources (A.4.6)
prompts: Confirm AI-specific competencies are recruited or trained.
Verify a roster of independent reviewers (red team, ethicists).

checklists.text: Dataset register includes lineage and sensitivity labels.
Compute capacity sized for current workloads.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: How do you manage dataset lineage and licensing?
Show us how you size training infrastructure for a new model.
